marks.view: Chat alone, then the review beside it

marks.note: Something's not quite right about the way the wrap is happening with the items in the chat. Also, why does it say Codex twice? What is that? Codex existing login, is that the name of the account or something? I guess that's fine. I think it's just the way you phrase it. I think it's fine, though. That part's good, but something about the way it wraps, I don't love. I think we can probably move some of them underneath as well. They don't all need to be in the text field, wrapping it. Also, where it says "What should an agent do?", I think it should be more like send off a task or what's next. and it should have the overseer logo there not the weird default logo. otherwise love the style.

I can't tell in Gate K where you typed in the term, so that's confusing me, but J looks good if it still works that way I think we might need to add a search to the sidebar version instead of it being inside of the overseer window like that. The overseer sidebar is the one I think that should have the search, and it should definitely be accessible via a hotkey/command palette, I think.

I think the dashboard from Chatalon looks fine. I just can't really tell what's happening here because there's no real data filling it. The grid certainly looks weird because here it says "No agents running." Then just do "New agent," but I think that should just go back to the default home with the chat. If you press grid, then you just have the ability to do it. I think this part's just a little strange. I don't fully follow what's happening here, and it might just be a data filling problem or how you've dragged things in.
